How many 1 5 pieces will you need to make a whole? He makes a whole using two different fraction pieces. The whole looks like the following. One piece of 1 2 and two pieces of 1 4 make a whole. What is the relation between 1 2 and 1 4 ? Discuss in class. 1 2 = 2 4 ( 1 2 is equivalent to 2 4 ). When a 1 2 piece is broken into 2 equal parts, each part is a 1 4 piece. 2 pieces of 1 4 are equal to 1 2 . What else is equivalent to 1 2 ? 1 2 = 2 4 = ____ = ____ = ____ 1 2 1 4 1 4 Is 1 3 equal to 2 6 ? Let us find out. Look at the picture and identify the fractions. Are there two different ways to write the fraction represented by the shaded part? ___________________ Do you see that 1 3 = 2 6 ? Yes. These are called ‘equivalent fractions’. Let us see how equivalent fractions can be generated.
